+## What
+Pin the wire shape of the new terminal-authentication types with hand-written fixtures. The exhaustive-over-tags test only checks that the `terminal` tag selects a modeled case; it does not check field round trips or the omit-when-nil rules.
+
+- [ ] In `Tests/FoundationModelsACPTests/TaggedUnionRoundTripTests.swift`, add a hand-written fixture for `AuthMethod.terminal`: decode `{"type":"terminal","methodId":"login","name":"Log in","args":["auth","login"],"env":[{"name":"FOO","value":"bar"}]}` with `WireRoundTrip.expectLossless`, assert `case .terminal(let payload)` with `payload.methodId == AuthMethodId(rawValue: "login")`, `payload.args == ["auth","login"]`, and `payload.env.count == 1`. +- [ ] In the same file, assert a `terminal` payload without `args` and `env` decodes to empty arrays (the schema marks them `x-deserialize-default-on-error`), and that an invalid item in `args` is skipped, not fatal (`x-deserialize-skip-invalid-items`).
+- [ ] In `Tests/FoundationModelsACPTests/InitializeNegotiationTests.swift` (or a new `AuthCapabilitiesRoundTripTests.swift`), add tests for `ClientCapabilities.auth`: `ClientCapabilities()` encodes with no `auth` key; `ClientCapabilities(auth: AuthCapabilities(terminal: TerminalAuthCapabilities()))` encodes `"auth":{"terminal":{}}`; decoding `{"auth":{"terminal":{}}}` gives a non-nil `auth?.terminal`; decoding `{"auth":null}` and `{"auth":{"terminal":null}}` gives nil, not a decode error.
+- [ ] Add an `InitializeResponse` fixture with `authMethods: [.terminal(...), .agent(...)]` and assert lossless round trip through `WireRoundTrip.expectLossless`.
+
+Context: generated types live in `Sources/FoundationModelsACP/Generated/Models*.generated.swift` and `Unions.generated.swift`. Use the existing helpers in `Tests/FoundationModelsACPTests/WireRoundTrip*.swift`. Check the exact initializer signatures in the generated files after the schema task regenerates them.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The new tests exist and pass.
+- [ ] `AuthMethod.terminal` round-trips losslessly with `args`, `env`, `description`, and `_meta`.
+- [ ] `ClientCapabilities.auth` is omitted from JSON when nil and encodes `{"terminal":{}}` when set.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `swift test --filter TaggedUnionRoundTripTests` passes.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter InitializeNegotiationTests` (or the new suite) passes.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes in full.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #schema-alpha3
\ No newline at end of file
